📌 Key points要点

⭐ Must know必须记住
  • Factor every denominator; LCD = each different factor at its highest power.把每个分母分解；最简公分母＝每个不同因式取最高次幂。
  • Rewrite over the LCD, then add or subtract the NUMERATORS only.化成同分母，只对分子加减。
  • Subtracting: bracket the whole numerator, −(x−2)=−x+2; finish by factoring and cancelling.相减时整个分子加括号，−(x−2)=−x+2；最后分解分子看能否约分。

💡 21​+31​=65​ — you already know how. Adding x−23​−x+12​ is the exact same move: common denominator, then combine the tops.21​+31​=65​ 你早就会。x−23​−x+12​ 是一模一样的操作：通分，再合并分子。

  1. Factor every denominator. The lowest common denominator (LCD) uses each different factor the greatest number of times it appears in any one denominator.先把每个分母分解。最简公分母（LCD）由各个不同因式组成，每个因式取它在单个分母中出现的最高次数。
  2. Rewrite each fraction over the LCD by multiplying its top and bottom by the missing factors. Then add or subtract the numerators only.把每个分式的分子分母同乘所缺的因式，化成以 LCD 为分母。然后只把分子相加减。
  3. Subtracting a fraction subtracts its WHOLE numerator: put it in brackets. −(x−2)=−x+2.减去一个分式，就是减去它的整个分子：一定加括号。−(x−2)=−x+2。
  4. Finish by factoring the numerator and cancelling if possible. State the NPVs from the original denominators.最后把分子分解，能约就约。不允许值由原来的分母给出。

🧮 Key formulas关键公式

BA​±DC​=BDAD±BC​
Adding/subtracting (use the LCD when the denominators share factors)分式加减（分母有公因式时用最简公分母）
🎯 Test tip考试提示
Most errors happen in the numerator after the LCD is set up. Write the full numerator with brackets on one line, expand on the next, and test with x=0 (or any allowed value) at the end.大多数错误发生在通分之后的分子里。先在一行写出带括号的完整分子，下一行展开，最后用 x=0（或任何允许值）代入检验。

🧭 How to get started怎么入手

Ask yourself these five, in order, before writing anything. Every worked example on this page is labelled with them.动笔之前，按顺序问自己这五个问题。本页每道例题的步骤都标了它们。

  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Factor every denominator first and write the NPVs from them (every value that makes any denominator 0).先把每个分母分解，并据此写出不允许值（凡是让任何一个分母为 0 的值）。
  2. 🎯 Asked求什么
    ONE fraction, numerator and denominator factored, with nothing left to cancel, plus the NPVs.一个分式：分子、分母都分解好，不能再约分，再加上不允许值。
  3. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    Line the factored denominators up in a row. Under each one, write the factors it is missing from the LCD.把分解后的分母排成一行，在每个分母下面写出它比公分母少了哪些因式。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Multiply each numerator by its missing factors. Write the whole new numerator on one line with brackets, then expand and collect.每个分子乘上自己缺的因式。先在一行写出带括号的整个新分子，再展开、合并同类项。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    Factor the numerator and cancel common FACTORS only. Then put one allowed value (like x=0) into the question and your answer — they must match.把分子分解，只约公「因式」。再取一个允许值（比如 x=0）代入原题和答案——两边必须相等。

🧱 Prerequisite check先修检查

4 quick Grade 9–10 questions, about 3 minutes. Miss one and a 5-minute repair card opens right there; fix it, then carry on.4 道九、十年级小题，约 3 分钟。错了就在原地打开 5 分钟补救卡，补好再继续。

1Fractions: add, subtract, multiply, divide分数的四则运算
Work out 43​−61​.计算 43​−61​。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Fractions: add, subtract, multiply, divide分数的四则运算 (Grade年级 7–9)
Add or subtract only with a common denominator: 21​+31​=63​+62​=65​. Multiply straight across. Divide = multiply by the reciprocal (flip the second fraction).加减必须先通分：21​+31​=63​+62​=65​。乘法分子乘分子、分母乘分母。除以一个分数＝乘它的倒数（把第二个分数倒过来）。
  1. 32​−41​: common denominator 12 → 128​−123​=125​.32​−41​：公分母 12 → 128​−123​=125​。
  2. 43​÷89​=43​⋅98​=3624​=32​.43​÷89​=43​⋅98​=3624​=32​。
  3. Never add denominators: 21​+31​=52​.分母不能相加：21​+31​=52​。
Try one:试一道：
Simplify 65​−41​.化简 65​−41​。

2Lowest common denominator最简公分母
What is the lowest common denominator of 4x1​ and 6x21​?4x1​ 和 6x21​ 的最简公分母是什么？

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Lowest common denominator最简公分母 (Grade年级 8–10)
Factor each denominator; the LCD uses every factor the HIGHEST number of times it appears. For 6 and 4: 2⋅3 and 22 → 22⋅3=12. For x and x2: x2. For (x+1) and (x−2): (x+1)(x−2).把每个分母分解；最简公分母取每个因式出现的最高次数。6 和 4：2⋅3 与 22 → 22⋅3=12。x 和 x2：x2。(x+1) 和 (x−2)：(x+1)(x−2)。
  1. 2x1​ and 3x21​: LCD =6x2.2x1​ 与 3x21​：最简公分母 =6x2。
  2. Multiply top AND bottom by what is missing: 2x1​=6x23x​.分子分母同乘缺的部分：2x1​=6x23x​。
Try one:试一道：
What is the LCD of x2−91​ and x+31​?x2−91​ 与 x+31​ 的最简公分母是？

3Distributing (and the minus sign)去括号（尤其是负号）
Simplify x−(x−5).化简 x−(x−5)。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Distributing (and the minus sign)去括号（尤其是负号） (Grade年级 8–9)
Multiply EVERY term inside the bracket: 3(x−4)=3x−12. A minus in front changes every sign inside: −(x−5)=−x+5, and 2−(x+3)=2−x−3=−x−1.括号里的每一项都要乘到：3(x−4)=3x−12。前面是负号时，括号里每一项都变号：−(x−5)=−x+5，2−(x+3)=2−x−3=−x−1。
  1. −2(3x−1)=−6x+2 (the −1 becomes +2).−2(3x−1)=−6x+2（−1 变成 +2）。
  2. x(x+2)−3(x+2)=x2+2x−3x−6=x2−x−6.x(x+2)−3(x+2)=x2+2x−3x−6=x2−x−6。
Try one:试一道：
Expand and simplify 4x−(2x−7).去括号并化简 4x−(2x−7)。

4Factoring x2+bx+c (product and sum)分解 x2+bx+c（积与和）
Factor x2−x−6.分解因式 x2−x−6。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Factoring x2+bx+c (product and sum)分解 x2+bx+c（积与和） (Grade年级 10)
Take out a common factor first. Then find two numbers that MULTIPLY to c and ADD to b: x2−x−12 → −4 and 3 → (x−4)(x+3). Check by expanding.先提公因式。再找两个数，相乘等于 c、相加等于 b：x2−x−12 → −4 和 3 → (x−4)(x+3)。展开检验。
  1. x2+7x+10: 2×5=10, 2+5=7 → (x+2)(x+5).x2+7x+10：2×5=10，2+5=7 → (x+2)(x+5)。
  2. If c<0 the two numbers have different signs; if c>0 they share the sign of b.若 c<0，两个数异号；若 c>0，两个数与 b 同号。
Try one:试一道：
Factor x2−2x−15.分解 x2−2x−15。

Topics this builds on:本知识点建立在： Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简

🪜 Worked → fill in → your turn例题 → 填空 → 自己做

Three versions of one idea: read a full solution, then finish a half-done one, then do one yourself with hints you open one at a time.同一个思路的三个版本：先看完整解答，再补全半成品，最后自己做——提示一次只开一个。

① Worked example — read it完整例题——看懂
Simplify x+34​−x−12​.化简 x+34​−x−12​。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Denominators x+3 and x−1 cannot be factored further. NPVs: x=−3, 1.分母 x+3 和 x−1 已不能再分解。不允许值：x=−3, 1。
  2. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    No common factor, so LCD =(x+3)(x−1). The first fraction is missing (x−1); the second is missing (x+3).没有公因式，所以公分母 =(x+3)(x−1)。第一个分式缺 (x−1)，第二个缺 (x+3)。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Numerator with brackets: 4(x−1)−2(x+3).带括号的分子：4(x−1)−2(x+3)。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Expand: 4x−4−2x−6=2x−10=2(x−5).展开：4x−4−2x−6=2x−10=2(x−5)。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    Nothing cancels. Test x=0: 34​+2=310​ and (3)(−1)2(−5)​=310​ ✓.没有可约的。代 x=0：34​+2=310​，(3)(−1)2(−5)​=310​ ✓。
✔
(x+3)(x−1)2(x−5)​, x=−3, 1(x+3)(x−1)2(x−5)​，x=−3, 1
② Same idea — you fill the gaps同一思路——你来补空
Simplify x−15​−x+23​.化简 x−15​−x+23​。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    NPVs: x=1, −2. LCD =(x−1)(x+2).不允许值：x=1, −2。公分母 =(x−1)(x+2)。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    ✍️
    Your turn: write the new numerator with brackets (do not expand yet).轮到你：写出带括号的新分子（先别展开）。
    5(x+2)−3(x−1)
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    ✍️
    Your turn: expand. Watch the sign of the last term.轮到你：展开。注意最后一项的符号。
    5x+10−3x+3=2x+13
  4. ✅ Check检验
    Test x=0: −5−23​=−213​ and (−1)(2)13​=−213​ ✓.代 x=0：−5−23​=−213​，(−1)(2)13​=−213​ ✓。
Answer答案
(x−1)(x+2)2x+13​, x=1, −2(x−1)(x+2)2x+13​，x=1, −2
③ Your turn — on paper first轮到你——先在纸上做
Simplify x2+x−6x+8​−x−22​ and state the NPVs.化简 x2+x−6x+8​−x−22​，并写出不允许值。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Factor x2+x−6 first. Which factor does the second denominator already share?先分解 x2+x−6。第二个分母和它共有哪个因式？
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    LCD =(x+3)(x−2). The second fraction is missing (x+3). Numerator: (x+8)−2(x+3).公分母 =(x+3)(x−2)。第二个分式缺 (x+3)。分子：(x+8)−2(x+3)。
  3. ✅ Check检验
    The numerator should come out as −x+2. Write it as −(x−2) and look for something to cancel.分子应得 −x+2。把它写成 −(x−2)，看看能约掉什么。
−x+31​, x=−3, 2−x+31​，x=−3, 2
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    x2+x−6=(x+3)(x−2). NPVs: x=−3, 2.x2+x−6=(x+3)(x−2)。不允许值：x=−3, 2。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Numerator: (x+8)−2(x+3)=x+8−2x−6=−x+2=−(x−2).分子：(x+8)−2(x+3)=x+8−2x−6=−x+2=−(x−2)。
  3. ✅ Check检验
    (x+3)(x−2)−(x−2)​=−x+31​. Test x=0: −68​+1=−31​ ✓.(x+3)(x−2)−(x−2)​=−x+31​。代 x=0：−68​+1=−31​ ✓。
How did it go?做得怎样？

Example 1例 1L1 Know知道
Simplify 2x3​+6x25​.化简 2x3​+6x25​。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    LCD of 2x and 6x2 is 6x2. Multiply the first fraction by 3x3x​: 6x29x​.2x 与 6x2 的最简公分母是 6x2。第一个分式乘以 3x3x​：6x29x​。
  2. ✅ Check检验
    6x29x+5​, x=0.6x29x+5​，x=0。
Answer答案
6x29x+5​, x=0

💡 Key idea解题思路
The LCD takes the lcm of the numbers and the highest power of each variable.最小公分母取数字的最小公倍数，字母取最高次幂。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Scale each fraction up to the LCD 6x2, then add numerators.把每个分式通分到 6x2，再分子相加。
Example 2例 2L2 Apply会做2 methods种解法
Simplify x−3x​+3−x2​.化简 x−3x​+3−x2​。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    3−x=−(x−3), so 3−x2​=−x−32​.3−x=−(x−3)，所以 3−x2​=−x−32​。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Same denominator now: x−3x−2​, x=3.分母相同了：x−3x−2​，x=3。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Use (x−3)(3−x) as the denominator: (x−3)(3−x)x(3−x)+2(x−3)​=(x−3)(3−x)−x2+5x−6​.以 (x−3)(3−x) 为分母：(x−3)(3−x)x(3−x)+2(x−3)​=(x−3)(3−x)−x2+5x−6​。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Top =−(x−2)(x−3), bottom =−(x−3)2, giving x−3x−2​. Correct, but three extra steps — spot opposites first.分子 =−(x−2)(x−3)，分母 =−(x−3)2，得 x−3x−2​。正确但多了三步——先认出相反式更快。
Answer答案
x−3x−2​, x=3
🧭 What this example trains这道题练什么
🎯 Goal考查目标
Add fractions whose denominators are opposites.加分母互为相反式的分式。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识
Adding & subtracting有理式加减Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简
💪 Abilities锻炼的能力
🧭 Choosing a strategy选择策略⚙️ Fluent procedures运算熟练🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理
💡 Key idea解题思路
Turn 3−x into −(x−3) and flip the sign of the second term so both denominators match.把 3−x 写成 −(x−3)，并让第二项变号，使两个分母相同。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Make the denominators the same by factoring out −1.提出 −1 使分母相同。
  • Use the brute-force LCD (x−3)(3−x): it works but the answer then needs extra simplifying.硬用 (x−3)(3−x) 当公分母：也行，但结果还要多一步化简。
Example 3例 3L3 Connect会用
Simplify x2−x−2x+5​−x−22​+x+11​ and state the NPVs.化简 x2−x−2x+5​−x−22​+x+11​，写出不允许值。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    x2−x−2=(x−2)(x+1). So the LCD is (x−2)(x+1), and the NPVs are x=2,−1.x2−x−2=(x−2)(x+1)，所以最简公分母是 (x−2)(x+1)，不允许值是 x=2,−1。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Second fraction needs (x+1): (x−2)(x+1)2(x+1)​. Third needs (x−2): (x−2)(x+1)x−2​.第二个分式缺 (x+1)：(x−2)(x+1)2(x+1)​。第三个缺 (x−2)：(x−2)(x+1)x−2​。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Numerator, with brackets: (x+5)−2(x+1)+(x−2).分子（加括号）：(x+5)−2(x+1)+(x−2)。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Expand: x+5−2x−2+x−2=1. The x-terms cancel completely.展开：x+5−2x−2+x−2=1。含 x 的项全部抵消。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    Answer: (x−2)(x+1)1​, x=2,−1. Check at x=0: −25​+1+1=−21​ and (−2)(1)1​=−21​ ✓.答案：(x−2)(x+1)1​，x=2,−1。用 x=0 验算：−25​+1+1=−21​，(−2)(1)1​=−21​ ✓。
Answer答案
(x−2)(x+1)1​, x=2,−1

💡 Key idea解题思路
Factor x2−x−2=(x−2)(x+1); it is already the LCD of the other two denominators.分解 x2−x−2=(x−2)(x+1)；它正是另外两个分母的公分母。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Factor all denominators, build the LCD, combine and cancel.分解所有分母，建立公分母，合并后约分。
  • Check with x=3: both sides equal 41​.用 x=3 检验：两边都等于 41​。

🔍 Common mistakes常见错误

Someone made each of these. Tap the line where it first goes wrong.每道题都有人这样做过。点出第一处出错的那一行。

1Adding the denominators too连分母也相加
Simplify x1​+31​.化简 x1​+31​。

🧠 It treats fractions like pairs of numbers. Even 21​+21​ would become 42​ that way, which is clearly wrong.把分式当成一对对的数来加。照这样 21​+21​ 会变成 42​，显然不对。

🔧 LCD 3x: 3x3​+3xx​=3xx+3​, x=0.公分母 3x：3x3​+3xx​=3xx+3​，x=0。

✔ 3xx+3​, x=03xx+3​，x=0

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q1 B

2The minus sign only hits the first term减号只作用到第一项
Simplify x−32x+1​−x−3x−4​.化简 x−32x+1​−x−3x−4​。

🧠 Without brackets the minus was attached to x only. It must change the sign of the whole second numerator: −(x−4)=−x+4.没加括号，减号只给了 x。它要改变整个第二个分子的符号：−(x−4)=−x+4。

🔧 x−3(2x+1)−(x−4)​=x−3x+5​, x=3.x−3(2x+1)−(x−4)​=x−3x+5​，x=3。

✔ x−3x+5​, x=3x−3x+5​，x=3

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q2 A, Practice练习 2

3Changing the bottom but not the top只改了分母，没改分子
Simplify x3​+x−12​.化简 x3​+x−12​。

🧠 The denominators were made bigger but the numerators were not multiplied by the same factor, so each fraction changed its value.分母变大了，分子却没乘同一个因式，于是每个分式的值都变了。

🔧 x(x−1)3(x−1)+2x​=x(x−1)5x−3​, x=0, 1.x(x−1)3(x−1)+2x​=x(x−1)5x−3​，x=0, 1。

✔ x(x−1)5x−3​, x=0, 1x(x−1)5x−3​，x=0, 1

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q1 C

4Treating opposite denominators as the same把相反的分母当成相同的
Simplify x−25​+2−x3​.化简 x−25​+2−x3​。

🧠 2−x and x−2 have the same numbers but opposite signs: 2−x=−(x−2). At x=3 one is 1, the other −1.2−x 和 x−2 数字一样，符号相反：2−x=−(x−2)。x=3 时一个是 1，一个是 −1。

🔧 2−x3​=−x−23​, so x−25−3​=x−22​, x=2.2−x3​=−x−23​，所以 x−25−3​=x−22​，x=2。

✔ x−22​, x=2x−22​，x=2

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Practice练习 4

5Cancelling terms instead of factors约掉了「项」而不是「因式」
Simplify x+3x​+x+36​.化简 x+3x​+x+36​。

🧠 The x here is a term joined by +, not a factor joined by ×. You may only cancel something that multiplies the WHOLE top and the WHOLE bottom.这里的 x 是用「＋」连着的项，不是用「×」连着的因式。只有乘在整个分子和整个分母上的东西才能约。

🔧 x+6 and x+3 share no factor, so x+3x+6​ is already simplest. (Test x=1: 47​=2.)x+6 与 x+3 没有公因式，x+3x+6​ 已经最简。（代 x=1：47​=2。）

✔ x+3x+6​, x=−3x+3x+6​，x=−3

⚠️ Quick list速查

  • Adding denominators: x1​+y1​=x+y2​. Only numerators are added, over a common denominator.把分母也相加：x1​+y1​=x+y2​。只有通分后的分子相加。
  • Not distributing the minus: x+1x​−x+1x−2​=x+1x−x+2​=x+12​, not x+1−2​.减号没分配：x+1x​−x+1x−2​=x+1x−x+2​=x+12​，不是 x+1−2​。
  • Using the product of denominators when they share a factor — it works, but leaves a big expression you then have to simplify.分母有公因式时仍直接相乘作公分母——也能做，但会留下很大的式子，还得再化简。

💡 Why it works为什么成立

Math Antics - Common Denominator ECD
mathantics · 6 min · ↗
A Grade 7 repair: if 21​+31​ still feels shaky, this makes the "multiply top and bottom by the missing factor" step obvious before you do it with x.七年级补漏：如果 21​+31​ 还没把握，先看这个，「分子分母同乘缺的因数」就一目了然，再去做含 x 的题。
⏩ From 0:00: why unlike number fractions cannot be added directly, and how multiplying by a fraction equal to 1 (like 55​) makes like fractions; worked examples at 2:25 and 3:56. About 5 minutes.从 0:00 开始：为什么分母不同的数字分数不能直接相加，怎样乘一个等于 1 的分数（如 55​）变成同分母；2:25 和 3:56 有例题。约 5 分钟。

🪜 Step by step一步一步

Adding & Subtracting Rational Expressions Easily
Mario's Math Tutoring · 7 min · ↗
Says "look at what each denominator is missing" — the same question this page asks — and is careful with the minus sign; seven minutes, no padding.他问的就是「每个分母缺什么」——和本页的方法一样——而且很小心处理减号；七分钟，不拖沓。
⏩ From 0:00: two examples. First, binomial denominators: find what each is missing, rewrite, and distribute the minus as "plus negative 3" (2:18). Second (3:03): a monomial denominator and a monomial-times-binomial one, building the LCD 10x2(x+1) and cancelling an x at the end.从 0:00 开始：两道例题。第一道分母是二项式：找每个分母缺什么，改写，把减号当成「加负 3」来分配（2:18）。第二道（3:03）：一个单项式分母和一个「单项式×二项式」分母，建公分母 10x2(x+1)，最后约掉一个 x。
Adding & Subtracting Rational Expressions- STEP-BY-STEP GUIDE - Part I Pre-Calculus 11 - Algebra I
Mathsupport · 9 min · ↗
A BC Pre-calc 11 teacher who insists on brackets around a numerator before multiplying and on leaving the answer factored — the two habits that prevent most errors here.BC 预科 11 老师，坚持乘之前给分子加括号、答案保持分解形式——这两个习惯能避免本节大多数错误。
⏩ From 3:42: after a number-fraction review, xx+2​ with a denominator 2 (LCD 2x, bracket the x+2 at 4:35), then same denominators (6:01), then a subtraction over (x+1)(x−1) (6:21) where he leaves the denominator factored.从 3:42 开始：复习完数字分数后，做 xx+2​ 和分母 2 的题（公分母 2x，4:35 给 x+2 加括号），然后是同分母（6:01），再做以 (x+1)(x−1) 为公分母的减法（6:21），分母保持分解形式。

1. x1​+x+11​=x(x+1) ?x+ ?​
( x + ) / ( x ( x + 1 ) )

✔ ( 2 x + 1 ) / ( x ( x + 1 ) )

x(x+1)x+1​+x(x+1)x​=x(x+1)2x+1​.x(x+1)x+1​+x(x+1)x​=x(x+1)2x+1​。

2. x−23​−x+22​=(x−2)(x+2) ?x+ ?​
( x + ) / ( ( x − 2 )( x + 2 ) )
The minus sign applies to the whole 2(x−2): −2x+4, not −2x−4.减号作用在整个 2(x−2) 上：−2x+4，不是 −2x−4。

✔ ( 1 x + 10 ) / ( ( x − 2 )( x + 2 ) )

3(x+2)−2(x−2)=3x+6−2x+4=x+10.3(x+2)−2(x−2)=3x+6−2x+4=x+10。

3. The lowest common denominator of x2−91​ and x2+6x+91​ is:x2−91​ 与 x2+6x+91​ 的最小公分母是：

✔ (x−3)(x+3)2

x2−9=(x−3)(x+3) and x2+6x+9=(x+3)2: use each factor the greatest number of times it appears.x2−9=(x−3)(x+3)，x2+6x+9=(x+3)2：每个因式取出现次数最多的那个。

4. x5​+2x3​=2x ?​
/ ( 2x )
Scale the first fraction to the denominator 2x: x5​=2x10​.先把第一个分式通分到分母 2x：x5​=2x10​。

✔ 13 / ( 2x )

2x10​+2x3​=2x13​.2x10​+2x3​=2x13​。

5. Simplify x−3x​−x−33​ (type a number).化简 x−3x​−x−33​（输入一个数）。
Keep going: it simplifies to a single number.继续化简：结果是一个数。

✔ 1

Same denominator: x−3x−3​=1 (for x=3).分母相同：x−3x−3​=1（x=3）。

🗣️ Explain it back用自己的话讲一遍

Your friend adds x1​+x+11​ and gets 2x+12​. What went wrong?朋友算 x1​+x+11​ 得 2x+12​。错在哪里？

Fractions cannot be added by adding tops and bottoms. First give both the same denominator x(x+1): x(x+1)x+1​+x(x+1)x​=x(x+1)2x+1​.分数不能分子分母各自相加。要先通分到同一个分母 x(x+1)：x(x+1)x+1​+x(x+1)x​=x(x+1)2x+1​。

Simplify x2+3x+23​+x2+4x+32​.化简 x2+3x+23​+x2+4x+32​。
(x+1)(x+2) and (x+1)(x+3).(x+1)(x+2) 和 (x+1)(x+3)。
(x+1)(x+2)(x+3)5x+13​, x=−1,−2,−3(x+1)(x+2)(x+3)5x+13​，x=−1,−2,−3
  1. LCD (x+1)(x+2)(x+3). Tops: 3(x+3)+2(x+2)=5x+13.最简公分母 (x+1)(x+2)(x+3)。分子：3(x+3)+2(x+2)=5x+13。
🎯 Goal考查目标
Add rational expressions whose denominators are trinomials sharing one factor.加分母为三项式且含一个公因式的有理式。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识
Adding & subtracting有理式加减Factoring trinomials ax²+bx+c三项式 ax²+bx+c 的分解Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简
💪 Abilities锻炼的能力
🧭 Choosing a strategy选择策略⚙️ Fluent procedures运算熟练🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理
💡 Key idea解题思路
(x+1)(x+2) and (x+1)(x+3) share (x+1), so the LCD is (x+1)(x+2)(x+3).(x+1)(x+2) 与 (x+1)(x+3) 共有 (x+1)，公分母是 (x+1)(x+2)(x+3)。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Factor each denominator and build the minimal LCD.分解每个分母，构造最小公分母。
  • Use the (bigger) product of both denominators as LCD and cancel at the end.用两分母的乘积（更大）做公分母，最后约分。

Simplify the complex fraction x−2x1​−21​​.化简繁分式 x−2x1​−21​​。
Combine the top first: 2x2−x​.先合并分子：2x2−x​。
−2x1​, x=0,2−2x1​，x=0,2
  1. Top =2x2−x​. Divide by x−2: 2x(x−2)2−x​=−2x1​.分子 =2x2−x​。除以 x−2：2x(x−2)2−x​=−2x1​。
🎯 Goal考查目标
Simplify a complex fraction by combining the numerator first.先合并分子，化简繁分式。

Adding & subtracting有理式加减Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除
💪 Abilities锻炼的能力

💡 Key idea解题思路
Combine x1​−21​=2x2−x​, then divide by x−2 and use the opposite-factor rule.先合并 x1​−21​=2x2−x​，再除以 x−2，用相反因式规则。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Combine the top, then divide.先合并分子，再做除法。
  • Multiply top and bottom by 2x to clear the small fractions.分子分母同乘 2x，去掉小分数。

8L4 Solve会想🌍 Modelling建模⚙️ Fluent procedures运算熟练🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理
A cyclist rides 60 km uphill to a lookout at x km/h and returns the same 60 km downhill at (x+10) km/h. (a) Write the total time as one fraction, simplified, and state the restrictions in context. (b) Write the average speed for the whole trip, total time120​, as a single simplified expression. (c) For x=20 find the average speed and explain why it is not the mean of 20 and 30.一名骑行者以 x km/h 的速度上坡骑 60 km 到观景台，再以 (x+10) km/h 的速度下坡骑回同样的 60 km。(a) 把总时间写成一个化简后的分式，并说明情境下的限制。(b) 把全程平均速度 总时间120​ 写成一个化简的式子。(c) 当 x=20 时求平均速度，并解释为什么它不是 20 与 30 的平均数。
LCD is x(x+10). Average speed is total distance over total time.公分母是 x(x+10)。平均速度 = 总路程 ÷ 总时间。
(a) T=x(x+10)60(2x+10)​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​ h, x>0; (b) vˉ=x+5x(x+10)​; (c) 24 km/h.(a) T=x(x+10)60(2x+10)​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​ 小时，x>0；(b) vˉ=x+5x(x+10)​；(c) 24 km/h。
  1. T=x60​+x+1060​=x(x+10)60(x+10)+60x​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​. Speeds are positive, so x>0 (and x=0,−10 is automatic).T=x60​+x+1060​=x(x+10)60(x+10)+60x​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​。速度为正，所以 x>0（x=0,−10 自然满足）。
  2. vˉ=120÷T=120(x+5)120x(x+10)​=x+5x(x+10)​.vˉ=120÷T=120(x+5)120x(x+10)​=x+5x(x+10)​。
  3. x=20: vˉ=2520⋅30​=24 km/h. Time uphill is 3 h and downhill 2 h, so 120 km in 5 h. More time is spent at the slower speed, so the average is pulled below 25.x=20：vˉ=2520⋅30​=24 km/h。上坡 3 小时、下坡 2 小时，共 120 km 用 5 小时。在较慢的速度上花的时间更多，平均速度被拉到 25 以下。
🎯 Goal考查目标
Add rational expressions from a rate context, simplify an average speed, and explain why it is not the simple mean.在速度情境中做有理式加法，化简平均速度，并解释它为何不是简单平均。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识
Adding & subtracting有理式加减Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简
💪 Abilities锻炼的能力
🌍 Modelling建模⚙️ Fluent procedures运算熟练🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理
💡 Key idea解题思路
Add times, not speeds; average speed is total distance over total time.要加的是时间，不是速度；平均速度 = 总路程 ÷ 总时间。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Algebra: LCD x(x+10), combine, then invert.代数：公分母 x(x+10)，合并，再取倒数。
  • Numbers: test x=20 (3 h + 2 h) and x=10 (6 h + 3 h) to see the pattern before generalising.数值：先试 x=20（3 小时 + 2 小时）和 x=10（6 小时 + 3 小时），看规律再推广。
